name: X: Search Posts
summary: Search X for posts from one handle, optionally within a date window, across top/latest/live tabs.
description: Search X for posts from one handle, optionally constrained to a date window, and return the matching posts as rzn.item/v2 items (one per thread). Use when you want posts from a single author either recent (latest/top) or within a specific interval. Do not use to read one post or expand a thread (use `x_open` for both).

max_posts.description: Upper bound on extracted posts. Defaults to 40.

since_date.description: Inclusive lower-bound date in YYYY-MM-DD form (X 'since:' operator). Omit for no lower bound.

timeline_mode.description: Which X search tab to land on (defaults to latest).

until_date.description: Exclusive upper-bound date in YYYY-MM-DD form (X 'until:' operator). Omit for no upper bound.

steps.name: Keep the SearchTimeline batches the page downloads (no request of its own)
Open x.com in a fresh tab so direct search navigation is cookie-safe

inputs.script: const cleanArg = (v) => { const t = String(v == null ? '' : v).trim(); return /^\{[a-zA-Z0-9_]+\}$/.test(t) ? '' : t; }; const handle = cleanArg(arg0).replace(/^@+/, ''); const since = cleanArg(arg1); const until = cleanArg(arg2); const rawMode = cleanArg(arg3).toLowerCase(); const mode = ['top','latest','live'].includes(rawMode) ? rawMode : 'latest'; const modeFlag = mode === 'top' ? 'top' : (mode === 'live' ? 'live' : 'live'); const parts = ['from:' + handle]; if (since) parts.push('since:' + since); if (until) parts.push('until:' + until); const q = parts.join(' '); const url = 'https://x.com/search?q=' + encodeURIComponent(q) + '&src=typed_query&f=' + modeFlag; setTimeout(() => window.location.assign(url), 0); return { handle, since, until, mode, search_url: url };

output_schema.description: rzn.items/v2 page (schema/rzn.items.v2.json): one rzn.item/v2 per thread, key x:post:<first post id>.

help.summary: Search X for posts from one handle, optionally within a date window, across top/latest/live tabs.

parameters.max_posts: Upper bound on extracted posts. Defaults to 40, max 100.
parameters.since_date: Inclusive lower-bound date in YYYY-MM-DD form (X 'since:' operator). Omit for no lower bound.
parameters.timeline_mode: Which X search tab to land on: top | latest | live. Defaults to latest.
parameters.until_date: Exclusive upper-bound date in YYYY-MM-DD form (X 'until:' operator). Omit for no upper bound.

examples.description: Most-recent posts from @elonmusk with no date window.

examples.command: rzn-browser run x search-posts --param handle="felixrieseberg" --param since_date="2026-03-10" --param until_date="2026-03-18" --param timeline_mode="live"
examples.description: Posts from @felixrieseberg between 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-18 on the Live tab.

returns: rzn.items/v2 page, listing feed: one rzn.item/v2 per thread (a lone post is a thread of one), key x:post:<first post id>, author, published_at (RFC 3339), published_in X, counts (likes, reposts, replies, quotes, bookmarks, views), marker edit:<edits>;posts:<n>, blocks of kind post plus one quoted block per quoted post, image/video URLs as attachments.
Reposts are not returned. A thread whose first post was not on the page, or with a gap, is returned with truncated set and is not indexed.
notes: Navigation is done via setTimeout + location.assign from the home page, which avoids the consent-overlay gotcha of typing into the landing search box.
Empty optional params are detected via the standard cleanArg helper.
timeline_mode=top uses the Top tab; latest and live both land on the Live tab.

Makes no request of its own: a capture_responses step keeps the SearchTimeline timeline batches the page itself downloads while it opens and scrolls, and the final step maps those (full text including long posts, exact counts, edit count, thread id), so posts X dropped from the page while scrolling are still returned. A post no captured batch carried comes back truncated (post_detail_unavailable) with the card's text.
